skill_name: Write an essay discussing the role of trust and credibility in relationships.
workflow: Trust and credibility are essential components of healthy relationships. Trust is the basis of any successful relationship and without it, none can exist. It is trust that can reassure, comfort, and bring stability to all kinds of relationships. Credibility is an important aspect of trust, as one must be credible to be trusted. To be credible, one has to be reliable, honest, trustworthy, and dependable. When someone is credible, they are seen as reliable, trustworthy and able to be counted on. C
